title: Notification settings
subtitle: Choose which groups show in the bell and which send a summary email every morning.

SCORES.name: Scores
SCORES.desc: Access requests, sharing, public approval, reviews, curated library

COMMENTS.name: Comments and suggestions
COMMENTS.desc: Mentions, replies to your comments, suggested edits

TEAMS.name: Teams and shows
TEAMS.desc: Invitations, role changes, assignments, due reminders

FORUM.name: Forum
FORUM.desc: Replies in your threads or threads you follow, best answers

offHint: Fully off: you won't get any notification from this group.
systemNote: Announcements from administrators always show in the app. The digest email is only sent when you have unread notifications from the last 24 hours.
